findings.location: task.prompt: «Обери правильне написання.» / «¿___ no comes?»; task.options[0] labels «Porque» incorrect.
findings.description: The prompt supplies no intended meaning or preceding dialogue. «¿Por qué no comes?» asks why; «¿Porque no comes?» can echo a proposed causal explanation. Question marks alone do not determine the spelling.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the learner must ask why the other person is not eating, for example by supplying the Ukrainian meaning «Чому ти не їси?».

items.reviewerAnswer: b for a why-question; a also fits an echo question confirming the reason «because you are not eating?».
items.notes: The curriculum suggests the intended why-reading, but the actual prompt does not state that meaning.
sources: User verdict definition: use uncertain when multiple reasonable readings remain unspecified.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Впиши porque або por qué.» / «¿___ no te gusta el té?»; task.errors[0] treats «Porque» as incorrect.
findings.description: Without a specified meaning or preceding dialogue, this can ask why the person dislikes tea or confirm «because you do not like tea?». Both spellings can form a grammatical question under those different readings.
findings.suggestion: Provide the intended Ukrainian meaning «Чому тобі не подобається чай?» or explicitly instruct the learner to ask for the reason.
